title: Trade Decision
description: trade-decision/v2: the document a trade-affirmed or trade-rejected event carries. Which it is lives on the event type, so the guards can read it; the document is an audit note.

address.description: The wallet address on that chain.

networkAccount.description: Optional, on a trade-affirmed only. The affirming party's own wallet on the collateral platform, for this trade. When absent, the pair's address book applies, else there is none.
